text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess has managed to leave
quite a
mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer! What training
should we
start off with today?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, energy means power! And power
means
strength!
choice_data_list: Bursting with energy today too, I see.
Full of energy today as well, I see.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Mmm... Well, the main point is
that
strength is vital!
choice_data_list: It feels like they're saying the exact same thing...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to need a lot more strength if I
hope to
become my ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want to continue to be someone I'm
proud of.
It's too soon to stop now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yes! Now then, I'll warm up with a
light run
around the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess starts running around
the
track. She called it a warm-up, but
she shoots
past like a gale.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: "You can become stronger than any raging storm."
'You can become stronger than a raging storm.'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, right, the next line is...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"My prince, how did my running and my
spirit
appear in your eyes?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I think that's enough reciting of
Princess
Fighter lines.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Tell me for real, Trainer. How do I look
in your
eyes?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I want to hear it in your own words.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And in my eyes, you're the ultimate
trainer!
